capabilities: Split grouped notes across each option of a list property in native Bases views
Configure what Kanban card drag does to the property's option list
List every property option as hidden groups in the Kanban Group menu
Copy diagnostics logs for troubleshooting issues
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installation is manual (copy main.js and manifest.json into the plugins folder). Interface available in English and Spanish.
intentEvidence: This works with native views without requiring the creation of new ones.
problem: Obsidian's Bases creates a single merged group (e.g. "Comedy Romance") for notes whose list property has multiple options, so such notes don't appear under each option.
summary: Bases enhancement that shows notes under every option of a list property when grouping, instead of one merged group, and adds Kanban drag options.
